regulations.enforcement_body: Clear Creek County Planning and Building Services
regulations.notes: Clear Creek County adopted Ordinance 19 (December 17, 2024), replacing previous STR regulations. Non-Primary Resident STR permits are capped at 4.5% of total residential units (162 permits for 2025). Primary Resident permits have separate processing. A new fee schedule adopted December 9, 2024. STR owners must collect lodging and sales tax from guests. Idaho Springs and Georgetown have their own regulations within their town limits.
